relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: Later, he obtained the doctoral degree of PhD from the same university (University of Calcutta) in 1953.

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: He also secured the degree of Doctor of Literature, in 1964, from the Jadavpur University.

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: Mukherji started his career as a lecturer at Calcutta University

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.role: Head of the department of Sanskrit
relations.evidence: moved to Jadavpur University in 1956 to join the Department of Sanskrit there where he eventually became the Head of the department.

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: In 1970, he was appointed as the vice chancellor of the University of Burdwan, a post he held till 1984.

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: The next three years were spent at Rabindra Bharati University as its vice chancellor and retired from there in 1987.

relations.subject: Ramaranjan Mukherji
relations.evidence: He was also a former chancellor of Rashtriya Sanskrit Vidyapeetha.
